Carlsbro Carlsbro "Alu" series browse by type eq/excite/filter/wah wah wah fuzz-wah browse by enclosure treadle Carlsbro Suzz Wah-Wah Published on July 26, 2005 Carlsbro "Alu" series fuzz-wah foot-controlled treadle early review early review Information The Carlsbro Wah Suzz is a combination unit integrating a traditional wah pedal with the Suzz fuzz circuit. Housed in a single enclosure with an expression treadle, the Wah Suzz enables both tonal filtering and distortion from one unified platform. The pedal includes two rotary controls: Gain , which governs the fuzz saturation level, and Sustain , which determines the length and compression of the distorted signal. The wah section operates via the rocker treadle, allowing real-time manipulation of the filter sweep. The two effects are internally connected, and while both are always in-line, their interaction is tailored for expressive, lead-oriented applications.
